title: How to top up wallet and pay renewals
body: Open Dashboard → Wallet, add funds with Paystack, then return to Dashboard and click Charge wallet on any due renewal.

title: What to do when a renewal is past due
body: Past due means payment was not collected on schedule. Add funds and charge manually before grace ends to avoid suspension.

title: Intake request vs formal proposal request
body: Use Get started for a quick interactive brief. Use the formal proposal request when you want structured scope, timeline, and cost sections.

title: How to generate a project estimate in GHS
body: Use the project cost calculator to choose platform, design, scope, and timeline. It gives a rough range in cedis and lets you download a proforma PDF.

title: Security checks before website launch
body: Minimum launch checks: HTTPS enabled, strong admin passwords, role-based access, backups, and monitoring alerts.

title: Which service should I choose?
body: Choose Web development for websites and browser-based platforms, Mobile apps for a new iOS or Android product, and Website to mobile app when you already have a working site you want assessed for store release.

title: What happens after I submit a project request?
body: Our team reviews your goals, timeline, constraints, and contact details. We then respond with clarifying questions or recommend the right discovery call, estimate, or proposal path.

title: How packages, estimates, and proposals differ
body: Packages show common starting scopes, the calculator gives a non-binding planning range, and a proposal confirms the tailored scope, assumptions, milestones, and fees for your engagement.

title: Google Maps listing and company facts
body: Our Company facts page lists verifiable office, pricing, and Ghana search topics. It also includes copy-ready text for Google Business Profile — business description, services, Q&A, and prompts you can send clients after delivery so reviews mention what was built. Keep the legal business name; paste wording only.

title: In-store POS vs ecommerce website
body: OceanCyber builds marketing sites and ecommerce stores (Paystack, Mobile Money, catalogue checkout). In-store POS — tills, branches, pharmacy or restaurant counters — is different software. We publish DwumaPOS planning guides (editorial, not a product we sell). Pick ecommerce if customers buy on the web; read the POS guides if staff sell at a counter.

title: Finding a web design or website development company in Ghana
body: If you searched on Google Maps for a web design company, website developers, or a development company in Accra or Ghana, use our local pages for packages in cedis, live portfolio links, and the same team that works from 47 Nii Kwashiefio Avenue.
